name: 600 EX long-cage rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 217 g for the RD-6207-GS long-cage assembly. The June 1984 catalogue conditions its 34T largest-sprocket limit on using Shimano SFR or PR fork ends; the 195 g short-cage figure belongs to a different assembly.
